concerns.text: User Story 2 (US2) tasks T004 and T005 depend on artifacts produced by User Story 1 (US1) – namely the processed parquet with structural_latent (T003). This violates the ‘independently‑shippable unit’ rule; each US block must be runnable without external tasks.

User Story 3 (US3) tasks T006‑T012 depend on outputs from US1 and US2 (splits, latent vectors, distilled model). Hence US3 is not an independently‑shippable unit, breaching the user‑story grouping requirement.
